_comment: Monotonic ratchet floor. Aether may only improve. These numbers are the FLOOR the gate enforces: the current build must meet or exceed them. When a self-teaching iteration ships a new detector, RAISE the matching number here in the same commit to lock the gain permanently (test_ratchet.py prints a reminder when current > floor). NEVER lower a number here — test_baseline_never_lowered compares every number against HEAD and against the merge-base with origin/main. The recall keys: min_corpus_claimed_findings = findings claimed by every `// expect:` header in the .aeth corpus; min_py_table_rows = rows in the five Python sink/sanitizer tables (tests/test_sink_rows.py pins each one).
